$ container --version
container CLI version 1.4.1

# Taken 2026-09-26 by asking the runtime directly (`container run --rm --name neko-1350 …`),
# nothing else running under that name. All five exit 1 with no stdout, and `container ls -a`
# listed nothing of that name afterwards. In order: (1) an image with no arm64 build
# (docker.io/amd64/busybox:1.36), a fresh pull; (2) the same run, image now local;
# (3) the same image with `--platform linux/arm64` written out, local; (4) the mirror, an
# arm64-only image (docker.io/arm64v8/busybox:1.36) asked for as linux/amd64, a fresh pull;
# (5) that again, local. A fresh pull (1, 4) words the failure `unsupported platform
# Platform(…)` and puts the platform that is MISSING in `_rawArch`; a local image says
# `platform linux/<arch>` (the wording platform-image-no-arm64-131.txt holds). Only these two
# images were measured: which others say the fresh-pull wording is not known.

$ container run --rm --name neko-1350 docker.io/amd64/busybox:1.36 true
